items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Mathematician’s Claude-Assisted Riemann Hypothesis Proof Certified by Lean and Mathlib Communities
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 數學家以 Claude 協助的黎曼猜想證明獲 Lean 與 Mathlib 社群正式認證
items_flat.summary_en: On November 20, Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge released a 17-million-line Lean formalization of a claimed proof of the Riemann Hypothesis (and generalized version for Dirichlet L-functions), developed over about six weeks with Claude. On November 21, the Lean FRO and Mathlib Initiative issued a joint statement certifying both the statement and the proof as correct after independent compilations and multiple proof checkers confirmed validity.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 20 日，Anthropic 數學家 Levent Alpöge 釋出約 1700 萬行的 Lean 形式化證明，聲稱在約六週內與 Claude 合作完成黎曼猜想（及 Dirichlet L-函數的廣義版本）證明。11 月 21 日，Lean FRO 與 Mathlib Initiative 聯合聲明，經獨立編譯與多個證明檢查器確認後，認證陳述與證明皆正確。
items_flat.analysis_en: Machine verification of a multi-million-line formalization marks a practical advance in AI-assisted mathematics, shifting the bottleneck from checking correctness to human understanding of the underlying ideas; a human-readable exposition is still pending and prize processes require further steps.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 數百萬行形式化證明的機器驗證標誌著 AI 協助數學的實用進展，瓶頸從正確性檢查轉向人類理解底層概念；人類可讀的完整闡述仍待完成，獎項程序也需要進一步步驟。
items_flat.quote: We have full confidence that Alpöge's proof of the Riemann Hypothesis is correct, and we congratulate him on this achievement. We hereby certify that both the statement and the proof of the Riemann Hypothesis are correct.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們完全有信心 Alpöge 對黎曼猜想的證明是正確的，並恭喜他取得此成就。我們特此認證黎曼猜想的陳述與證明皆正確。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Chief Scientist Proposes Shared Perplexity-Based Limits on Frontier AI Development
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 首席科學家提出以 Perplexity 為基礎的前沿 AI 發展共享限制
items_flat.summary_en: On November 22, OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki published “Perplexity and Intelligence,” disclosing internal log-perplexity figures (GPT-3.5 ~0.99, GPT-4 ~0.91, recent models below 0.8, a math-capable model ~0.76) on a held-out codebase dataset and proposing common limits based on perplexity and other measurements that labs would not cross until concrete monitoring milestones (e.g., successor to CoT monitors) are met. Sam Altman endorsed the post as one of OpenAI’s most important recent publications and linked it to White House Accords commitments.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 22 日，OpenAI 首席科學家 Jakub Pachocki 發表《Perplexity and Intelligence》，揭露內部 log-perplexity 數據（GPT-3.5 約 0.99、GPT-4 約 0.91、近期模型低於 0.8、某數學能力模型約 0.76），並提議以 perplexity 及其他測量為基礎的共同限制，實驗室承諾在達到具體監控里程碑（如 CoT 監控的後繼者）前不跨越。Sam Altman 背書此文為 OpenAI 近期最重要發表之一，並連結至白宮協議承諾。
items_flat.analysis_en: Publishing concrete pretraining metrics creates a potential cross-lab yardstick for pacing, but the proposal’s effectiveness depends on other labs adopting comparable measurements and agreeing to the limits; challenges include dataset differences and the metric’s detachment from specific capabilities.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 公布具體預訓練指標可創造跨實驗室的潛在節奏衡量標準，但提案效力取決於其他實驗室採用可比較測量並同意限制；挑戰包括數據集差異以及該指標與特定能力的脫節。
items_flat.quote: I further propose common limits, based on perplexity and other measurements, that developers are committed to not crossing until our ability to understand and monitor AI behavior achieves a certain concrete milestone.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我進一步提議基於 perplexity 及其他測量的共同限制，開發者承諾在我們理解與監控 AI 行為的能力達到某個具體里程碑之前不跨越。
